notes.title: We're Patching! KungFu Kickball v1.0.2.7
notes.content:
Attention Grand Masters!

Yes, that's right! We are bringing you a patch for KungFu Kickball which introduces many quality of life changes as well as some bug fixes. See the main points below:

[list]
[*] Alternate methods to unlock characters
[*] Added 'Team Select' as an option in the pause menu (offline games only)
[*] Previous character choices are now automatically pre-selected (offline games only)
[*] Added win/loss totals under user's names on the win screen of online matches
[*] Better messaging about match starting
[*] Added bells and removed music in 'Practice while you wait' mode
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34146832/55b44c26f2c74a84d27e3e130596be67daca7499.gif[/img]

notes.title: Early Access - Phase 4 Patch
notes.content:
Thank you again for the overwhelming response to the new features and introduction of THE MONKEY KING in Phase 3! We love the positivity from our community!

Finally, we can share to you what is included in Phase 4 - and it’s available RIGHT NOW! Read on below for the details of this brand new update!

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
If you came here for the patch notes, here's the list of things we've added:

[h3]Additions[/h3]
[olist]
[*] [b]Added Instant Replays -[/b] Relive your intense goals in the heat of battle!
[*] [b]Added new Announcers -[/b] Alongside the original English voice over, KFK now has Standard Chinese and Sichuan Chinese announcers! You may even get to select a special announcer who knows KungFu Kickball like the back of his hand...
[*] [b]Custom online matches now support Random Level-Select -[/b] Custom online matches are even more fleshed out. We even threw in a new ball that will blow the competition away!
[*] [b] We also went under the hood to tweak and polish the UI/UX, and fix a few niggly bugs! [/b]
[*] [b]And finally, introducing THE SHOGUN! -[/b] A brand new unlocked character for all, as part of the base roster!
[/olist][olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34146832/c4203c49e6edbe5fb171ab7a91d3d148ba67ea12.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34146832/d4944b60d8d3d530ca9dc6b11f2ce04e199375ea.gif[/img]
[/olist]
This is likely the final update before we exit Early Access for KungFu Kickball (when you will then be able to compete against people across all consoles via cross-play!). Keep on kicking and we hope you enjoy the new content from Phase 4!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34146832/2bb1715c38f0808a9e112bdd502bc9958f58c2c7.png[/img]

Custom online matches now support Random Level-Select - Custom online matches are even more fleshed out. We even threw in a new ball that will blow the competition away!

notes.title: Early Access - Phase 3 Patch
notes.content:
Thank you for the overwhelming response to the new features and introduction of THE PANDA in Phase 2! It has been unreal!

What do we have in store for you in Phase 3, you ask? Read on to find out!

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
If you came here for the patch notes, here's the list of things we've added:

[h3]Additions[/h3]
[olist]
[*] [b]Unlocked Grand Master difficulty mode -[/b] Beat Master difficulty to unlock!
[*] [b]OG skins available to unlock -[/b] OG skins for THE MONK, THE ASSASSIN, and THE OLD MASTER. How do you unlock these, you ask? OK, for you, we're going to let you in on the secret:

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34146832/2a0c8aa0b182eb4763f2acc76422c68d6633edee.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34146832/3e9bfeb5abe225c20cb017db076c57b33a91172f.png[/img][/url] beat Grand Master difficulty in Arcade Mode to unlock!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34146832/e50de91b2ab91cf1b8bbba5842c17174c10bd8e1.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34146832/862a67bf58a5f39c70b42df124462e59d9cf0764.png[/img][/url] defeat two Master difficulty AI's on your own in Versus Mode to unlock!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34146832/856c06dc9354f268bbd4c2a3ce00d7d811c35db2.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34146832/3319c4d13ea84999eb69f04b43f53122eae4be6e.png[/img][/url] defeat two Grand Master difficulty AI's on your own in Versus Mode to unlock!

[*] [b]Custom online matches -[/b] So.. many.. options.. now in online flavor! (plus a new ball!)
[*] [b]Hosted online matches now support multiple players per machine -[/b] The more, the merrier!
[*] [b]Added an easy to scan Discord QR code during 'Practice while you wait' -[/b] Come join the community and find more people to challenge!
[*] [b]And introducing THE MONKEY KING! -[/b] Beat the game on Master to unlock!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34146832/55b44c26f2c74a84d27e3e130596be67daca7499.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34146832/34365ccaa541b734ce52b7e42452e73a363d7227.gif[/img][/olist]
We already can't wait to share with you Early Access Phase 4 when it's finishing baking - see you then!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34146832/d4ac32368f3e9bda335c6fd9fdb184870040b48c.png[/img]

notes.title: Early Access - Phase 2 Patch
notes.content:
3.. 2.. 1.. GO!

It's been so much fun watching everyone battle it out, trying for the ever-satisfying GONG! of the bell. We have enjoyed receiving your words of encouragement and hearing all your wonderful ideas and wishes for the game moving forward.

It's why we're excited to now share with you Phase 2.

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
If you came here for the patch notes, here's the list of things we've added:

[h3]Additions[/h3]
[olist]
[*][b]Hosted online matches -[/b] Invite friends to come fight!
[*][b]Custom local matches -[/b] So.. many.. options..
[*][b]Local tournaments -[/b] Whose kickball will reign supreme?
[*][b]Rematch functionality -[/b] Come on, best 3 out of 5!
[*][b]Quickplay 2v2 teaming up with a local player -[/b] Have a friend over? Go to battle against others!
[*][b]Practice while you wait -[/b] No more twiddling your thumbs!
[*][b]And introducing THE PANDA! -[/b] Beat the game on Teacher or Master to unlock!
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34146832/9da20faa9c4ca6536b796ca48ac1e9e3000e1446.gif[/img]

See you all again when it comes time for Early Access Phase 3!

notes.title: Early Access - Phase 1 Patch
notes.content:
[h1]KungFu Kickball - Early Access Phase 1 Patch[/h1]
We're very happy with how KungFu Kickball has been received so far! We hope you're all having fun trying the game and you're excited for more updates to come 👀 We have quite a few plans for the game in the pipeline!

We want to thank everybody who has given their suggestions and has reported their experience to us. We're working hard to fix any issues you might have experienced, and we have a batch of minor fixes detailed below.

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
If you came here for the patch notes, here's the list of things we've added:

[h2]Additions[/h2]
[olist] [*] [b]Cinematic Intro[/b] - You can watch the cinematic intro now!
[*] [b]New Difficulty[/b] - Unlock of Arcade mode AI difficulty: Teacher! [/olist]
And the things we've fixed:

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[olist] [*] [b]Main menu softlock[/b] - Softlock (buttons disappearing) when user left the main menu too fast is now fixed
[*] [b]Slow-mo effect[/b] - Slow-mo effect after scoring wasn't showing in online play, but it will now
[*] [b]Timer[/b] - Timer had a chance of not doing the countdown in online play, will every time now
[*] [b]Sound effects[/b] - Kickball and bell sounds sometimes weren't sounding in online play, but they will always trigger now
[*] [b]Low-res elements[/b] - General quality improvement for some visual elements
[*] [b]Typos[/b] - Fixed a minor typo in Settings > Video options
[*] [b]Credits[/b] - Credits appeared crunched (text overlapped itself), has proper spacing now [/olist]
See you all again when it comes time to Early Access Phase 2!
